summary: Iteration 12 regression pass over the code-cleanup refactor (server.py helper split, React useCallback effects, ternary->map/helper replacements, stable keys). Backend: full suite now 191 tests (159 pre-existing + 32 new in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py). Result: 189 passed / 2 failed — ZERO regressions from the refactor (all 159 previous tests pass, including the previously-failing completed_at guard). The 2 failures are pre-existing/uncovered state-machine bugs in the complete action, exposed by the two new tests I added. Verified behaviour-preservation of every refactored function: trade lifecycle propose->accept->meetup->complete x2->rate (completed_at persisted, successful_trades +1 on both sides, referral verification hook fires for referrer AND referred user), /listings filters (kind=have|need|service, case-insensitive category 'home'->'Home', q, mine=true (+401 without auth), verified_only, has_photos, radius=25) and sorting (recent|closest|reputation with emergency contiguous at top, closest ascending, reputation descending, no _id leak), /matches/chains schema {you.listing, b.{listing,user}, c.{listing,user}} on a synthetic 3-way loop (cached wants_of works) + empty list for fresh user + 401 unauthenticated, /dashboard/stats exact 10-key contract with counters reacting to created listings and to an active->completed trade, /community/dashboard rich schema + emergency_count >= len(emergency) + recent_completed_30d now increments, auth via Bearer AND via session_token cookie (+401 on garbage cookie / no creds). Frontend Playwright: landing (hero, how-it-works, trust, FAQ, all CTAs) on desktop+mobile, /discover and /community public, /login and /signup (getSubmitLabel renders 'Sign in' / 'Create account'), UI signup -> onboarding -> /dashboard via httpOnly cookie, /matches (chains section + match cards + Propose trade -> trade detail), /trades list, /messages DM send + inbox, /listings, listing detail kind badge + share verb for all 3 kinds (HAVE/I've got, NEED/Looking for, CAN DO/Offering), referral panel (Profile > Invite Friends tab) with invite URL + copy + share + /invite/{code} landing. No console errors and no 4xx/5xx API calls in authenticated navigation.

critical.issue: No state guard on the 'complete' handler. (1) A DECLINED (or still 'proposed', never-accepted) trade can be driven to status='completed' by both parties calling action=complete — reproduced: trade declined by recipient, then both sides call complete -> status becomes 'completed' (HTTP 200/200) and successful_trades is incremented for both users. (2) Calling complete AGAIN on an already-completed trade re-runs _finalize_completed_trade, re-incrementing successful_trades (1 -> 2), re-firing rating-request notifications and emails, and rewriting completed_at. Fix: in _handle_trade_complete, reject unless t['status'] in ('accepted','meetup_planned') (400 'Invalid action or state: complete'). Repro tests: tests/test_iteration12.py::TestTradeLifecycle::test_complete_on_unaccepted_trade_should_be_rejected and ::test_repeat_complete_on_completed_trade_is_idempotent.

minor.issue: Chain dedup key is (my_have, b_have, c_have) only, so the same 3-listing loop is returned once per B/C ordering — UI showed 4 'CHAIN OF 3' cards for a single synthetic A/B/C loop (visible duplicates). Consider keying on the frozenset of the participant listing ids (or of user ids) so a loop appears once.

Not a code bug, but 40 orphaned TEST_* listings from earlier iterations were still live in the DB and were surfacing in real user-facing surfaces (/matches chains, /community by_category). I deleted them. total_users is also inflated (~1516) by ephemeral test signups; consider a cleanup script or a TTL/flag on test accounts.

issues: Location line renders a dangling separator when the user has no city/state — shows '— ,' (em-dash + comma). Guard the comma when state is empty.

Large empty region between the 'Browse all listings' link and the footer when the dataset is small; content block does not fill the viewport (footer floats mid-page). Consider min-height on the main content area.

action_items: HIGH: add a state guard to _handle_trade_complete — only allow action=complete when trade status is 'accepted' or 'meetup_planned'; this fixes both (a) completing declined/unaccepted trades and (b) double-complete re-incrementing successful_trades and re-sending rating/email notifications.
Dedup /api/matches/chains on the unordered set of participants so one loop isn't returned in multiple B/C orderings.
Minor: fix '— ,' location string on /profile when state is empty.
Optional: clean up leftover TEST_* users (listings already purged) so public /community counters reflect real data.
critical_code_review_comments: The refactor is behaviour-preserving (159/159 legacy tests green) and readability improved, but _handle_trade_complete lost/never had the state validation the other three handlers have — accept/decline/cancel all validate state, complete does not. Add it to the same pattern.

_TRADE_ACTIONS dispatch excludes 'complete' and is special-cased in trade_action; consider putting complete in the dict with a partial/closure so the dispatch is uniform and no future action can bypass the branch.
server.py is still 1615 lines (>700 threshold). The helper extraction makes the split into routers (auth/listings/trades/community/messaging) straightforward — do it next.

_sort_listings silently falls back to 'recent' for any unknown sort value; consider validating sort against a Literal['recent','closest','reputation'] so typos return 422 instead of quietly wrong ordering.
eslint on Listings.jsx reports 3 pre-existing react/no-unescaped-entities errors (lines 41, 163) — unrelated to the refactor but the file does not lint clean.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already enables xdist; do NOT pass -n). test_iteration12.py is the refactor regression file: TestTradeLifecycle (lifecycle + referral hook + idempotency/state guards), TestListingFilters (class-scoped fixture creates 4 listings incl. an emergency one), TestMatchesChains, TestDashboardStats, TestCommunityDashboard, TestAuthPaths. API gotchas: POST /api/trades requires my_listing_id + their_listing_id + to_user_id; meetup body is {location_name, date, time, location_type} and moves status to 'meetup_planned'; GET /api/referrals/mine returns 'referral_code' (not 'code'); the ReferralPanel lives on /profile under the 'Invite Friends' tab (data-testid=tab-referral), NOT on /dashboard as the review request stated. Clipboard copy shows a 'Couldn't copy' toast in headless Chrome (permission), not a product bug. Two-user UI setups can be done by fetching /api/auth/signup for user B from the page (cookie switches to B) then POST /api/auth/login to switch back to A.
rca_of_the_issue: trade_action dispatches accept/decline/cancel through _TRADE_ACTIONS (each validating status) but routes 'complete' to _handle_trade_complete, which computes role, sets {role}_completed and, when both flags are true, calls _finalize_completed_trade — with no check on the current trade status. Consequences: (a) a trade in 'proposed'/'declined' state can be marched to 'completed'; (b) for an already-'completed' trade both flags are already true, so every subsequent complete call re-enters the finalize branch and re-increments successful_trades ($inc, not idempotent) plus re-queues rating notifications/emails. Reproduction is in tests/test_iteration12.py (two tests). Mitigation: `if t['status'] not in ('accepted','meetup_planned'): raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid action or state: complete')` at the top of _handle_trade_complete.
